title: Shropshire's mystery Iron Age fort dug up after 40 years, its secrets still unclear
summary_full: In Shropshire, archaeologists are unearthing the mysteries of Wall Camp, a unique Iron Age fort. Over the course of ten years, the project will delve into the fort’s defensive structures, its intriguing internal design, and explore how the surrounding marshlands were utilised. Previous finds, such as roundhouses and pottery, hint at the fort's connections to salt-trade networks, shedding light on historical practices and construction techniques.
